Gate evidence: worktree @ 06c88b0, rustc 1.98.1. just check exit 0 (fmt-check; clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -D warnings; cargo test --workspace --all-targets --locked = 1 passed; actionlint -color; markdownlint-cli2 0 issues/15 files) with CARGO_TARGET_DIR=***REDACTED-PATH*** Diff = 1 line in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.md. act -n attempted but blocked: act 0.2.89 hangs resolving remote action github/codeql-action@b96794f (pinned by dependabot PR #2) and ignores HTTPS_PROXY; zero workflow files changed, actionlint validates syntax.

PR opened: https://github.com/bitty-terminal/bitty-ai/pull/4 (head 5b2097aaf5bb87b8167bd008251d53196255cb78, labels chore,area:ci,P2, milestone v0.1.0). Not merged: awaiting independent review + CI. Branch grep confirms zero 1.97.1 references.

AI-0004 done: bitty-ai-docs submodule added at docs/ pinned at 39b4c7568a8807e0940bd298660c972db0cfa92a; bitty-docs/docs/ai refs retargeted; AGENTS/README/CONTRIBUTING/commitlint updated. just check green with submodule. PR bitty-ai#5 opened, not merged.

Built bitty-ai-slice: real generic bitty-ipc reuse (pinned rev 3c9cfea); deterministic local provider; terminal.snapshot context over wire+scope+consent; read-only tool bus via McpClientStub; RC-10 stream. 10 tests green. Gates: just check, cargo deny, MSRV 1.85, windows-gnu, act -n ci. PR bitty-ai#7 open, docs PR bitty-ai-docs#4. Gaps G-1..G-6 recorded. Stopping at open PR (not merging).

Review fix on PR #7 head 9332eee: corrected the accepted-32KiB wording in context.rs:17 and provider.rs:3/11 (now a candidate CP-5/OQ-066 profile, not an accepted core bound); clarified stream.rs constant docs; added chunk_over_rc10_ceiling_fails_closed so RC-10's 256 KiB CHUNK_CEILING is exercised separately from the slice-local 64 KiB MAX_FRAGMENT_BYTES that rejects the 70 KiB case. just check + cargo test -p bitty-ai-slice green (11 tests). Not merged. Companion docs fix pushed to bitty-ai-docs PR #4 head be8a10d.
Verified merged on main: 7cb4d84 (#8) ports the ancestry-based snapshot gate and publication provenance; bitty-ai snapshot (5399d44) trailer matches main and the gate is green.
